ios.desc:
Experience the calm and clarity of the Dao De Jing every day with DailyDao.

Welcome to DailyDao, a simple yet enriching app that brings the teachings of the Dao De Jing to your fingertips. Each day, discover a new chapter from this ancient text, translated into clear, modern English for easy comprehension.

Features:

Daily Insights: Receive a new chapter daily, offering a moment of calm and insight amidst life's hustle and bustle.
Understandable Translations: Our translations are designed to be accessible, opening up the wisdom of the Dao De Jing to all.
Full Text Available: The complete Dao De Jing is yours to explore with an in-app purchase option.
DailyDao is perfect for anyone looking to add a touch of tranquility and insight to their daily routine. Whether you're well-versed in Eastern philosophy or simply exploring, our app offers an inviting and effortless path to engaging with these enduring teachings.

Try thinking about some minor annoyance in your life and if you can solve that with a simple app, or something you really enjoyed that could be made into an app.

Some things I’ve done —
